data.message: I propose 10 tons each this month: 25 × 10 = 250, leaving 250 so next month's stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That supports $10,000 each every month without collapse risk if everyone follows it. I intend to request 10 and invite everyone to do likewise. Let's review revealed catches afterward and keep future total catches at no more than half the available stock.
